profile: Existing frontend redesign with protected product structure
prompt: Refresh an existing product UI while preserving its positioning, features, information architecture, page relationships, and interaction flows.
expected_actions: inspect current source and rendered states, repository design assets, and the freshest product truth before proposing changes
classify the UI impact as preserve unless evidence proves a material product decision is unavoidable
record positioning, features, information architecture, page relationships, and flows as protected scope
propose a coherent visual and component direction without collapsing distinct domain pages into title-only reuse
verify representative rendered states, responsiveness, keyboard/focus behavior, accessibility, and fidelity to protected flows
forbidden_actions: change navigation, features, page relationships, or workflows as an incidental design improvement
treat an older design document as more authoritative than current source or runtime without a migration decision
make different domain pages identical merely to maximize component reuse
require a new high-fidelity design when current evidence makes the bounded preserve change implementation-ready
